notes.title: Update 191028
notes.notes:
To use save file made before this update, you should load your game and press 'sync old save file' button in system tab. don't press twice.
You should set 'character never fall below time option' more than 3.5 seconds.





Eastern conqueror soldier roaster added including war elephant and camel rider. They can be recruited by Monaka in Trequartistar with aliqus stone.
Monaka exchange epic grade item with aliqus stone.
General flag size is proportion to general's power
Chariot can be upgraded from imperial melee cavalry
Tanks and gunners try to keep 22m distance from enemy
Better face mouse morph.
Guns have bullet trail.
Throwing weapon reload works better.
Melee soldiers sometime do jump attack.
Character rotation always follow player camera rotation when attacking.
AI faction has delay to follow player civilization.
Fast travel mode does not change time speed.
Block and light source makes less frame drop.
Character preset export function added.
Throwing weapon soldiers throws in high arc and ignore obstacles. 
Night viliage music loop has delay. 
Autosave before battleoption added
Projectile give more damage with more character torque
Castle wall artillery changes by age.
Old boots take off when wear new boots.
Gotikke soldier clothes stretching fixed.
No more being attacked by enemy in village right after loading.
Battle result window pops up when win.
Two seasons and 6 weather. Press 'k' to update random weather. usually sunny.
Attack animation reversed when hit enemy armor is way better than attackers' weapon.
Vehicle spawn button added. Only one chance after one battle/
Added attack way indicator. can be turned off in option tab
When player attack civilian, guards try to arrest player.
All Equipment stat changes by it's rarity.
Neutral general shown in map. They always give epic items.
Soldier production building produce soldiers of current age.
Enemy faction sands assassins.
New housing item- civilian spawner, guard spawner, trader spawner.
Stone wall has simple ladder.
New side job- treasure hunt. New item- treasure map.
Language option divided by Interface language and dialogue language. 
If first hit target is dead, melee weapon can hit more target. you can see krosa kills three litanian with one swing.
Mouse release does not stops attack. 
Right click on enemy orders soldier to attack only them. this is useful for archers.
A new companion added. 
New stories added. 
Civilian talks each other. companions and player character replies to civilian. 








Not much update left before full release and it's time to start optimization.

Below are updates will be release in next 30 days.

Optimization for 30% better frame rate.
Character facial expression and animation when talking.
Civilian, companion use furniture, eat, sleep, rest.
Battle size system.
Vehicle soldier click selection.
Japanese interface translation.

Chinese dialogue translation will be done 50 days. Interface translation would take one more week.

notes.title: Update 190829 - Block
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/myDP6CaFyM8


Block based building system added.
The number of block has nothing to do with frame rate.
You can build more than 10,000 blocks.
The only matters is dynamic light source like lanterns. It drops much frame rate.



You can export your buildings so that bring old saved game buildings to new game. You can share your exported building file.



No more major update for a while because I have to ready to update main stories. It will take about 2 more months for translation, voice act record for scenario left.
If there is update, it will be described in below, not in new notice.




Update 190826-
Enemy tank has different color.
Allocated additional shop and soldier manager to some castle.
Tank treads moves faster.
Added reload key - [R]. It changes magazine and drop left bullets.
Added reload and bolt action sound.
Player and companion physics not explode when spawned with tank unit
Vehicle HP bar added.
Can not become TPS mode in deployed mode.
Replenishing generals are immortal
Arrow ammunition have limit.
Day length became 2.2 times longer
Root box drops more scrap. drops less item.
Soldier fall below land telleport to surface when they wake up.
Quest marker tracks Panbagnat and Presalle after Bastoni defence test.
Move speed and status apply bug fixed in battle.
AI general generate soldier slower.
Added companion follow distance toggle key - [F10]
Can see soldier wage in statistics tab
Item drop table changed.
AI castle generate soldier of current age.


update 190831

When press tab to end battle, Player return to TPS mode first.
Housing height control speed is not effected by frame rate.
Impact armor decrease impact damage by % calculation. Max stat is 80%
Arrow and tank cannon don't slow down when attack close enemy
Injured soldier number does not exceed soldier item number itself.
No more gangster griped pistol
Actuator icon changed.
Ranged soldier shoot less diverse unit. It's good for optimization.
Litania cavalry offset fixed.
Added camera shaking.
Lowered lantern brightness.
Hide horse HP bar when end battle.
Player character spawn in high air after battle bug fixed.
Character teleports to surface if she is fall deep below landscape.
Melee soldier don't stop moving on cliff.

notes.title: update 190603 - pickaxe
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/6dVzoPP2DZQ


https://youtu.be/x_Lm6Le1y40




If you want to use old version save file, load your save game and than press [import landscape] button in system tab.





Trader sales tools and paints in productive housing menu.





Three system option added.

CPU thread dedicated to landscape loading - set this value 1/3 of your total thread. 
the more dedicated thread, the less frame drop when camera angle and location changed.


Landscape sight range - set this value 6 if you fulfill recommended PC spec.



VRAM useage - If you have low texture resolution problem, change this option. never set this value more than 80% of graffic card RAM








You can export landscape in system tab.
If you click that button, game remake LandscapeVoxel.sav file in save folder so that you can import landscape from old save file or upload to mod community.
Housings cant be exported for now. I will add that option about a month later.








昔のセーブファイルを使う為にはロードした後[import landscape]を押してください。ボタンはsystemにあります。

トレーダーが道具とペンキを売っています(buy productive housing)


三つのオプションが追加されました。

CPU thread dedicated to landscape loading　-　自分のCPUスレッドの三分の一に設定してください。多いほどカメラが移動したときにプレーム落ちる時間を短くします


Landscape sight range　-　十分なCPUなら6に設定してください。
7にすると景色はいいですがよくプレームがゼロになります。
適用の為にはゲームを一度終了する必要が有ります。


VRAM useage -テキスチャー全体が単純になる問題が出来るとこの数字をいじってください。


systemの export landscapeボタンを押すとLandscapeVoxel.savファイルを作り直します。
このファイルを利用して新しいゲームに昔のセーブファイル地形をコピーしたり、他の人が作った地形をコピー出来ます

notes.title: Beta update 190530 - Mining crafting
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/x_Lm6Le1y40

If you use old save file, press [import landscape] button in system tab (never press export button first).


You can buy pickaxe and painters from trader- productive housing.

Don't dig too deeper because there is kill Z zone.

You can export landscape in system tab.
if you click that button, game remake LandscapeVoxel.sav file in save folder so that you can import landscape from old save file or upload to mod community.

Some castle gates are below the surface so you have to dig to enter village. this will be fixed in this weekend.
Civilians removed temporally.





When using pickaxe

Right click - dig

Right click + Shift - Inflate

Right click + Alt - Flatten

[N] key  -  toggle dig strength


   B key - let companion out of way



When using painter

Right click - paint

Right click + Shift - remove






This feature was planed for Girls' civilization 2.
But because current landscape streaming system takes too much VRAM and makes micro stuttering , it is applied to this title.

The game take 3GB of RAM when it starts.
Editing landscape takes RAM more and more up to 60% of your total RAM capacity.

notes.title: beta update 190521

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34066119/521c35f00b9870106a6c13d0eaa94a88c7c76ddb.png[/img]



Soldier tier upgrade system added.


You can buy only lowest tier soldiers.

Soldier item remember it's accumulated EXP.

You need both enough EXP and resources to update soldiers.

Soldier item get EXP after winning battle

Injured soldier has upgrade priority so that one upgrade heals one soldier.






Injury system added.

There is high chance to be injured not destoryed.

Injured soldier are not spawned in battle.

but it heals every day and night.

Equipped soldier heals faster.

I will add skill about healing speed and injury rate soon.

Intact soldiers have priority when being equipped.






Soldier Item never lose it's saved EXP and injured information even while being merged, splitted, moved , equipped.

When Soldier Item is splitted, it divides EXP and not injured soldier has priority.

When it's merged, it merge EXP and injured soldier number.





bug fix- generals not start battle while player is in castle.
weapon not ignores enemy now.
castle unloaded properly when move outside of village right after load saved game.

notes.title: Actual play video (24min)
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/1EKYcaLJDYc




This is open world RTS



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34066119/5da718192380ecbbf21f6ec2138ca771f186ad89.png[/img]


Close combat system is real close to perfect, except for wooden part of pikes don't  have collision. This makes pikes OP. I expect two months to add collision.

It's sure melee combat system is exciting, even just watching soldiers also enjoyable.



Girls are tiny, horses are big.
That makes hard using one hand weapon on horse. 
AI cavalry fight well with one hand weapon but player won't.



Ranged weapon is not perfect. Crosshair does not follow bows, making it harder to aim. but you can use all kind of them anyway.
Both aiming and reload motion are strange now.
It's not exciting at all using bows. Throwing spear and crossbow give much better excitement but not as much as melee weapon


Most villages are not decorated. not a single prop, not a single siege defence craft. 
because there are about 20 castles, I can not decorate them all at once.
But there are at least one guard and trader every village so all castle acts as intended.

notes.title: Housing system_dev190310
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/2HBnp-3iecI



Some building produce soldiers/resources/money every week.


If the province your building located is yours , produced soldiers directly added to garrison.

In case it's not your territory, you have to talk to village manager so that you can take produced soldiers.




Someone don't like to invest any time on building own buildings whereas the others want sand box style building system.

So I added both already-merged house prefabs and raw house parts.





While in besieging, only guard towers and cannons will be shown for optimization.

Player constructed castle wall could be added later like defense game but not in early access state
